/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, os, re
files=[('human','refs/cds/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cds.all.fa.gz'),('mouse','refs/cds/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.cds.all.fa.gz'),('pig','refs/cds/Sus_scrofa.Sscrofa11.1.cds.all.fa.gz')]
out='refs/cds/combined_cds.fa'
t2g='refs/cds/t2gene.tsv'
with open(out,'w') as fo, open(t2g,'w') as tg:
    for sp,path in files:
        with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.startswith('>'):
                    h=line[1:].strip()
                    tid=h.split()[0]
                    gene=re.search(r'gene:(["'^'"\\s]+)',h)
                    sym=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(["'^'"\\s]+)',h)
                    desc=re.search(r'description:(.*?)(?: \\[Source:|"'$)'"',h)
                    gene_id=gene.group(1) if gene else ''
                    symbol=sym.group(1) if sym else gene_id
                    description=desc.group(1) if desc else ''
                    new=f'{sp}|{tid}'
                    fo.write(f'>{new}\\n')
                    tg.write('\\t'.join([new,sp,gene_id,symbol,description])+'\\n')
                else:
                    fo.write(line)
print(os.path.getsize(out), os.path.getsize(t2g))
PY
minimap2 -d refs/cds/combined_cds.mmi refs/cds/combined_cds.fa"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, re, collections, math
# Load read index -> barcode, UMI
cbs=['']
umis=['']
with gzip.open('three.way.barnyard.q2.R1.fq.gz','rt') as f:
    rec=0
    while True:
        h=f.readline()
        if not h: break
        seq=f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); f.readline()
        rec+=1
        cbs.append(seq[:16]); umis.append(seq[16:28])
print('reads', len(cbs)-1)
# target mapping
target={}
with open('refs/cds/t2gene.tsv') as f:
    for line in f:
        tid,sp,gene,sym,desc=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        target[tid]=(sp,sym,desc)
sp_counts=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
sp_gene_reads=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
sp_gene_umis=collections.defaultdict(set)
read_sp_total=collections.Counter()
used=0; skipped=0
readno_re=re.compile(r'READ_(\\d+)')
with open('cds_primary.paf') as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        qname=p[0]; qlen=int(p[1]); qstart=int(p[2]); qend=int(p[3]); tid=p[5]
        matches=int(p[9]); aln=int(p[10]); mapq=int(p[11])
        if aln < 45 or matches / max(aln,1) < 0.88:
            skipped+=1; continue
        m=readno_re.match(qname)
        if not m: continue
        i=int(m.group(1))
        if i>=len(cbs): continue
        cb=cbs[i]; umi=umis[i]
        sp,sym,desc=target[tid]
        sp_counts[cb][sp]+=1
        read_sp_total[sp]+=1
        sp_gene_reads[sp][sym]+=1
        sp_gene_umis[sp].add((cb,umi,sym))
        used+=1
print('used',used,'skipped',skipped,'read_sp_total',read_sp_total)
# barcode classification across thresholds
